title: Case: A delivered household item is confirmed broken
context: The merchant has already reviewed its inline damage-inspection record. The next action is a replacement request to the party authorised to approve it.
initial_request: I would prefer the same lamp rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve a replacement.

events.body: My parcel DL-77135 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

Thanks,
Orla
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

Inline inspection record TG-5202: ceramic table lamp arrived with a separated base; recipient report reviewed against our returned-item inspection. Damage accepted for replacement assessment. Dispatch DL-2210 has completed; replacement approval is not yet recorded.
Hi, any update on DL-33171? It was meant to come Thursday. Thanks.
I would prefer the same lamp rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve a replacement.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Please approve a like-for-like lamp replacement for TG-5202 using your accepted inspection record. Gideon has selected replacement in the order thread.
DL-65165 rebooked for Tuesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Replacement authorisations, Copperhythe Goods restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Merchant approval and reserved stock do not establish replacement dispatch or receipt.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-022: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's.
